display_name: YouTube Data API - Search, Videos, Comments, Transcripts, Channels
summary: YouTube data API: search videos, Shorts and channels, then pull video metadata, comments and replies, transcripts, related videos, download streams, and channel info, videos and community posts. Returns title, view count, duration, published time, channel and caption fields as JSON. 15 endpoints, 1-8 credits each.
